not_a_score: subjects are not ordered by novelty. Identity is a distance from a database and score ordering tracks database proximity, so the ordering here is by how many residue reads point at the subject
caveat: a 107 nt query against a large index finds about 40 bases at about 88% by chance and the chance band reads identically on residue and identified reads, so every row carries its worst E-value as well as its median
